item.title: v1.0.2
item.description: ### Improved - **Cleaner project lists.** Projects that live in temporary folders (left behind by tools that run Claude Code once per task) no longer fill Directories, Recent Projects and Sessions. Usage still counts what they cost. - **Clearer folder prompts.** When macOS asks whether Xylem may open your Desktop, Documents, Downloads or an external or network drive, the prompt now says why: Claude Code and the shell in your tabs need it to work with your projects there.

item.title: v1.0.1
item.description:
### New - **Worktree button.** The strip under the terminal has a Worktree button: a new branch in its own folder, opened in a new tab (the same as Cmd+K "Git · New Worktree Tab…"). It is greyed out, with the reason in its tooltip, when the tab's folder isn't a git repository. - **Help > Open-Source Licenses.** A window with every open-source library inside Xylem (SwiftTerm, Sparkle, the Sentry SDK), what each one does and its full license. The About window is short again: the website and the library names.
### Improved - In a narrow window the bottom strip shows icons only, with the names as tooltips, instead of cutting its labels short.

item.title: v1.0.0
item.description:
### New - **Automatic updates.** Xylem checks for a new version every few hours, downloads it in the background and installs it when you quit. Xylem > Check for Updates… shows what's new and can install it right away; Settings > General > Updates turns the automatic check off. - **Crash reports.** If Xylem crashes, it sends a report so the bug can be fixed: the error, macOS version, Mac model and Xylem version - never your prompts, files or IP address. - **Estimated costs are marked.** A model Xylem doesn't have a price for yet is priced like the newest model of its family, and the Usage dashboard now says so: an "estimated" tag on its row and the estimated part under Total Cost.
### Improved - Right panel: section arrows before the titles, clearer headers, and Claude/Git and This project/All switches across the full width. The panel refreshes by itself; Cmd+K "Refresh Sidebar" is still there. - Settings > General fits without scrolling.
### Changed - Xylem now runs on Apple silicon Macs only (M1 or newer).
